title: Rise of Community Barter Systems
description: In the wake of the market collapse, citizens begin to abandon traditional commerce in favor of community-led barter systems. This shift fosters stronger local ties but may also lead to inequalities in resource access.
flavor: As neighborhoods come together, the spirit of cooperation reignites, yet shadows of disparity loom.
response_hint: Enacting trade regulations could stabilize commerce but might challenge the emerging local systems.
